title: SkillDefinition
description: A built-in skill the server can offer to agents, as listed by `GET /v1/agentHarness/skills`. Skills are defined in server code. A harness only turns them on or off.

name.description: Stable name a harness uses to turn the skill on or off.

description.description: What the skill teaches an agent to do.

defaultEnabled.description: Whether the company default is seeded with the skill turned on.
